name: Speak with Coleman
summary: In Brill, Deathguard Dillinger sends proven fighters to Coleman Farthing for help. Their meeting in the tavern opens the way to a private matter tied to the old Agamand lands.

sections.title: A Word from the Guard
sections.body: You have helped contain grave threats near Brill, including Ulag the Cleaver. So Deathguard Dillinger trusts your strength. He watches the roads into town and chooses who can take on work beyond the usual patrols. Seeing you are ready, he points you toward people who need specialized help.

sections.title: A Private Vendetta
sections.body: Not every fight in Tirisfal Glades begins with orders from the Undercity. The surviving undead of Lordaeron still bear grudges over the lands, families, and fortunes they left behind. Coleman Farthing waits in the Gallow's End Tavern for a fighter willing to strike at threats near former settlements such as the Agamand Mills.

faq.q: Where can I find Coleman Farthing?
faq.answer: Coleman Farthing waits inside the Gallow's End Tavern on Brill's eastern side in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Who sends you to talk to Coleman?
faq.answer: Deathguard Dillinger guards the path into Brill. He sends you to Coleman after you prove your fighting skill.

faq.q: What kind of work does Coleman Farthing have?
faq.answer: Coleman Farthing seeks a capable fighter to take revenge on enemies of the Forsaken. Matters around the old Agamand properties are at stake.

faq.q: What prerequisites are needed before receiving this task?
faq.answer: Deathguard Dillinger refers you to Coleman after you defeat Ulag the Cleaver and prove your loyalty and combat skill to the Forsaken.

faq.q: Does this mission grant substantial rewards directly?
faq.answer: Speaking with Farthing in the tavern connects you with his personal requests. The meeting brings no substantial gear or coin on its own.

faq.q: What is the Gallow's End Tavern?
faq.answer: The Gallow's End Tavern is Brill's central inn, where local undead gather and rest. It is also an informal meeting place for private contracts.

angles.text: Many Forsaken carry personal grudges alongside their loyalty to the Dark Lady. Coleman Farthing's requests show how personal loss and the defense of Tirisfal are bound together.
As a Horde traveler helping secure Lordaeron, you gain a foothold for work across Tirisfal Glades by meeting Brill's townsfolk.
